lidar.binning: beam angle a (rad, CCW, 0 = forward) wrapped to [-pi, pi) goes to bin floor((a + pi) / (2 pi / bins)); each bin is the min valid range; returns that are non-finite, outside [range_min, range_max] of the scan or below min_range count as max_range; then clip to max_range and divide by it

observation: goal in base frame (x fwd, y left) from odometry, m / goal_obs_scale
last clamped actions, newest first, (fwd, turn) pairs
